# bread_bag — realism QA repair

Curved loaf, red/white Rudolph label, checked border and clear film ends; hidden underside unresolved.

## Evidence and numerical review

Three original calibrated frames: f2164, f2155, f2180. Mean silhouette IoU 0.8081. Photo contours are hand traced, with approximately 2–4 px uncertainty at 256 px crop resolution. Explicit masks exclude selected occluders. Wire masks additionally use a dark-pixel threshold. This is not certified segmentation ground truth.

Comparison: [photo / render / overlay](../review/bread_bag_compare.jpg). Full calibration, masks and measurements: `../review/bread_bag/`.

Grades: evidence=B, silhouette=B, proportions=B, colour_texture=C, articulation=C, physics=C, collision=B, instances=B

## Changes

- Added three original calibrated photo crops, traced photo masks and numerical comparisons.
- Added explicit mass basis/uncertainty, constituent density, material-specific friction, restitution, COM prior and fragility.
- Separated loaf contents from a 60-micron crinkled polyethylene wrapper.
- Curved the printed band around the loaf and added loose sealed film ends.
- Corrected package pose/scale from source silhouettes; added deformable film/bread parameters.
- Updated nominal mass prior to 500 g loaf plus 6 g wrapper, with source and identification uncertainty.

## Remaining

- Bag folds and hidden loaf shape remain approximate.
- No deformable runtime or tear model is wired to a simulator.
- Third-view silhouette remains below the requested A/B target where reported.
- Real present mass, friction, restitution and stiffness have not been measured; physics values are explicit priors.
